cards.front: mammal
cards.back: An animal with hair or fur. Mammal babies drink milk from their mother.
cards.say: mammal. An animal with hair or fur. Mammal babies drink milk from their mother.

cards.front: bird
cards.back: An animal with feathers, wings and a beak. Birds lay eggs.
cards.say: bird. An animal with feathers, wings and a beak. Birds lay eggs.

cards.front: fish
cards.back: An animal that lives in water. It has fins and scales and breathes under water.
cards.say: fish. An animal that lives in water. It has fins and scales and breathes under water.

cards.front: reptile
cards.back: An animal with dry scales on its skin. Snakes and lizards are reptiles.
cards.say: reptile. An animal with dry scales on its skin. Snakes and lizards are reptiles.

cards.front: insect
cards.back: A small animal with six legs. Ants, bees and butterflies are insects.
cards.say: insect. A small animal with six legs. Ants, bees and butterflies are insects.

cards.front: amphibian
cards.back: An animal that starts life in water and later can live on land too. A frog is an amphibian.
cards.say: amphibian. An animal that starts life in water and later can live on land too. A frog is an amphibian.

cards.front: Which group is a cat in?
cards.back: Mammal. A cat has fur and drinks milk as a baby.
cards.say: Which group is a cat in? Mammal. A cat has fur and drinks milk as a baby.

cards.front: Which group is a parrot in?
cards.back: Bird. A parrot has feathers and a beak.
cards.say: Which group is a parrot in? Bird. A parrot has feathers and a beak.

cards.front: Which group is a shark in?
cards.back: Fish. A shark lives in water and has fins.
cards.say: Which group is a shark in? Fish. A shark lives in water and has fins.

cards.front: Which group is a snake in?
cards.back: Reptile. A snake has dry scales.
cards.say: Which group is a snake in? Reptile. A snake has dry scales.

cards.front: Which group is an ant in?
cards.back: Insect. An ant has six legs.
cards.say: Which group is an ant in? Insect. An ant has six legs.

cards.front: Which group is a frog in?
cards.back: Amphibian. A frog starts life in water.
cards.say: Which group is a frog in? Amphibian. A frog starts life in water.

cards.front: Which group is a cow in?
cards.back: Mammal. A cow has hair and gives milk.
cards.say: Which group is a cow in? Mammal. A cow has hair and gives milk.

cards.front: Which group is a lizard in?
cards.back: Reptile. A lizard has dry scales.
cards.say: Which group is a lizard in? Reptile. A lizard has dry scales.

cards.front: Which group is a bee in?
cards.back: Insect. A bee has six legs and wings.
cards.say: Which group is a bee in? Insect. A bee has six legs and wings.

cards.front: Which group is a whale in?
cards.back: Mammal. A whale lives in the sea but it is a mammal. Its babies drink milk.
cards.say: Which group is a whale in? Mammal. A whale lives in the sea but it is a mammal. Its babies drink milk.

cards.front: Which group is a penguin in?
cards.back: Bird. A penguin has feathers and lays eggs, but it cannot fly.
cards.say: Which group is a penguin in? Bird. A penguin has feathers and lays eggs, but it cannot fly.

cards.front: Which animal is a bird: a bat or an owl?
cards.back: An owl. An owl has feathers and a beak.
cards.say: Which animal is a bird: a bat or an owl? An owl. An owl has feathers and a beak.

cards.front: Which animal is a fish: a goldfish or a frog?
cards.back: A goldfish. A frog is an amphibian.
cards.say: Which animal is a fish: a goldfish or a frog? A goldfish. A frog is an amphibian.

cards.front: Which animal is a mammal: a dog or a snake?
cards.back: A dog. A dog has fur.
cards.say: Which animal is a mammal: a dog or a snake? A dog. A dog has fur.

cards.front: Which animal is an insect: a butterfly or a fish?
cards.back: A butterfly. It has six legs.
cards.say: Which animal is an insect: a butterfly or a fish? A butterfly. It has six legs.

cards.front: Which animal is a reptile: a crocodile or a rabbit?
cards.back: A crocodile. It has dry, hard scales.
cards.say: Which animal is a reptile: a crocodile or a rabbit? A crocodile. It has dry, hard scales.
